name: df-app
description: ΔF — dark tabbed interface with C# debug parser

scripts.build:parser: dotnet publish src/DebugParser.csproj -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true --output parser-bin
scripts.build:parser:win: dotnet publish src/DebugParser.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true --output parser-bin
scripts.build:parser:mac: dotnet publish src/DebugParser.csproj -c Release -r osx-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true --output parser-bin
